source.name: Talents Forever
source.changes: Normalized class/tree/talent identifiers and field names, and left out the per-talent source, icon and hotfix-date fields (each class’s source line names its hotfix days); no talent text or rank values changed. Icons and artwork omitted.
limits: Fan-maintained read of beta client build 1.60.1.70755 plus the server hotfixes of 3, 4, 6 and 10 November 2026 from the beta hotfix cache, as each class’s source line states; not a live-client read or independent in-game verification.
Some values follow Blizzard’s development notes of 2 November 2026 ahead of game data; where the notes name a row but no column, the column is the source’s choice.
Classic fields are the source comparison reference, normally rank-one text; the source gives no exact Classic client build.
This is a Forever calculator with Classic comparison, not a complete separately allocatable Classic all-rank calculator.
Standard level-10-to-60 point budget only; Legacy Talented extra points are not modeled.
The data license covers the author’s reading, checking and arrangement. Blizzard game names, tooltip text and artwork remain Blizzard’s and are not licensed by the source.

artImportNote: Build .170 separately imported redistributed Blizzard artwork. The 10 November mapping reuses those exact files where a talent keeps an icon that is already on file; talents whose icon is not on file are listed in art.json and show the calculator’s plain no-art tile. No new artwork was fetched.

archive.label: 16 October beta data
archive.use: Read-only. The calculator loads it only to open a build code made on this revision; new builds and attachments use the current snapshot.
